# P2P.me

> Pay with USDC at any QR code using P2P.me. P2P.me is a self-custodial, peer-to-peer platform on Base (Ethereum L2) that lets you buy USDC with local currency, sell USDC to your bank or mobile-money account, and pay any merchant QR code with USDC. No KYC is required to start.

Official app: https://app.p2p.me
Website: https://p2p.me
Docs: https://docs.p2p.foundation

## What P2P.me does

- Buy USDC: send local currency via UPI, PIX, QRIS, M-Pesa, bank transfer and more, and receive USDC in your own wallet.
- Sell USDC: receive local currency directly to your bank, UPI, PIX or mobile-money details.
- Scan & Pay: scan any merchant QR code and pay with USDC; the merchant receives local currency.
- Deposit / Withdraw: bridge USDC and other tokens in and out from Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, BSC and more.
- Limits: increase transaction limits with zero-knowledge verifications of social accounts; no personal data is stored.
- $P2P token: governance and utility token of the P2P Protocol, with trust staking ("Circles of Trust").

## Supported countries and payment rails

- India (INR) - UPI
- Indonesia (IDR) - QRIS
- Brazil (BRL) - PIX
- Argentina (ARS) - Alias / CBU
- Venezuela (VES) - Pago Movil
- Bolivia (BOB) - QR Simple
- Nigeria (NGN) - NIP bank transfer
- Colombia (COP) - Transferencia
- Cuba (CUP) - Transfermovil
- Ecuador (USD) - Transferencia
- Peru (PEN) - Yape / Plin / CCI
- Philippines (PHP) - InstaPay
- Kenya (KES) - M-Pesa

## Key facts

- Self-custodial: users hold their own funds; P2P.me never takes custody.
- Network: USDC on Base. Transactions are gasless via EIP-4337 account abstraction.
- Merchants are verified with zero-knowledge proofs of banking history before onboarding.
- No KYC to start; optional privacy-preserving verification for higher limits.
- Languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Indonesian, Hindi.
